mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over 3 consecutive months signals robust consumer demand, which drives corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods with positive RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a robust labor market recovery, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month, coupled with a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1%, signals inflationary pressure without corresponding monetary tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month and FEDFUNDS < 1%
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 consecutive months signals a strong demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods with positive HOUST growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% in a quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
